faces.name: That Which Was Compleated
faces.oracleText:
Ward—You get two poison counters.
Annihilator X, where X is the total number of poison counters your opponents have.
When you cast That Which Was Compleated, you may put a card an opponent owns in exile into their graveyard. If you do, they get two poison counters.

faces.name: That Which Was Taken
faces.oracleText:
{4}, {T}: Put a divinity counter on target permanent other than That Which Was Taken.
Each permanent with a divinity counter on it has indestructible.

faces.name: That's Enough Slices
faces.oracleText: When you encounter this phenome-nom, each player creates a Pizza token. If that player has the least life or is tied for the least life, they create two Pizza tokens instead. Then planeswalk away from this phenome-nom. (A Pizza token is a Food artifact with "{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this token: You gain 6 life.")

faces.name: That's No Moonmist
faces.oracleText: Transform all artifacts and Phyrexian creatures on their front face. Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt this turn by creatures other than Phyrexians. (Only double-faced cards and tokens can be transformed.)

faces.name: That's Rough Buddy
faces.oracleText:
Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. Put two +1/+1 counters on that creature instead if a creature left the battlefield under your control this turn.
Draw a card.

faces.name: Thatcher Revolt
faces.oracleText: Create three 1/1 red Human creature tokens with haste. Sacrifice those tokens at the beginning of the next end step.
